macros.name: fancylabel
macros.doc: The \fancylabel command always checks if a label for <marker> already exists and creates it if not.

macros.name: fancyref
macros.doc: \fancyref prints the reference of <marker> and remembers that this <marker> has been requested.

macros.name: fancysublabel
macros.doc: The \fancysublabel command is working in the same way as \fancylabel while providing a second level of referencing.

macros.name: fancysubref
macros.doc: \fancysubref prints the label and sublabel of <marker> and <submarker> and remembers the request.
